description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Intel is hiring a CAD/EDA Tools Software Engineer for its Foundry Technology Manufacturing team. The role develops and maintains software tools, automation flows, and methodologies that support hardware design, process design, and manufacturing, while improving engineering productivity across the hardware design lifecycle.
CAD/EDA Tools Software Engineer building and testing design-automation software, physical-design workflows, and distributed job-management tools

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, test, and debug software tools, flows, and methodologies used in design automation environments
• Capture user stories and requirements from internal stakeholders and translate them into actionable technical solutions
• Write both functional and test code to ensure high-quality, maintainable software deliverables
• Automate build and deployment pipelines to streamline tool delivery and updates
• Perform unit, integration, and end-to-end testing of software tools to validate functionality and reliability
• Develop and maintain scripts and automation frameworks to support physical design, place and route, and DRC verification workflows
• Collaborate with hardware design, process design, and manufacturing teams to identify automation opportunities and improve design methodologies
• Support the administration, deployment, and maintenance of CAD software and EDA tool infrastructure
• Develop job management tools on distributed computing systems to optimize resource utilization and workflow efficiency
• Standardize and document processes through workflows, templates, and reusable automation components
• Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of software development best practices

Requirements:
• Master of Science degree, in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or in a related STEM field
• 6+ months of experience in the following:
  + Solid programming and scripting languages such as Python, or C++
• 6+ months of experience in the following:
  + Experience working on Linux environments, version management systems and EDA Tools

Preferred:
• Ph.D. degree, in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or in a related STEM field
• 12+ months of experience in the following:
  + Industry-standard EDA tools such as Cadence Virtuoso, Synopsys ICV, Siemens Calibre for use in physical design, place and route scripts, and DRC verification
• 12+ months of experience in the following:
  + Development of job management tools on distributed computing systems
• 12+ months of experience in the following:
  + Automate processes whether standardized through workflows, templates, and other means
• 12+ months of experience in the following:
  + Knowledge of CAD software administration and deployment
